_comment: Expectations for the frozen real-page snapshots in fixtures/real. Authored from measured behaviour, not guessed. The retention band is the guard against silent content destruction: a void-element bug once cut a 297 KB article to 3.4 KB (retention 0.011) while every unit test passed. Bands are deliberately wide enough to survive normal rule tuning and tight enough to catch a collapse. Refresh with: bun run fixtures/capture.ts

example-com._note: Minimal HTML that is mostly a <style> block. Fired hidden_content_ratio_high until the ratio was scoped to concealment rules.

wikipedia-article._note: Large article: heavy nav, many genuinely hidden elements, void tags. Exposed the truncation bug (retention was 0.011).

python-docs._note: Technical documentation. Scored 0.538 on raw-byte repetition and was ABORTED as a tarpit until the measure moved to visible text.

iana-page._note: Small institutional page with ordinary site furniture.

rfc-plaintext._note: text/plain. No markup exists, so no rule may remove a single byte.

json-api._note: Structured non-HTML. Must pass through byte-identical; its 0.40 text repetition is the closest legitimate case to the tarpit threshold.
